dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli on the lateral flank show irregular, non-geometric perimeters with a distinct dark-to-light gradient from the exterior border to the interior core. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-gray pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, localized primarily along the dorsal ridge and the upper-anterior flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the mid-flank region form an irregular quadrilateral. A secondary grouping of three high-intensity blobs near the dorsal-posterior transition forms an obtuse-angled triangle.
